tool.title: Judge whether a pull request may land
tool.description: The enforced merge guard: asks GitHub's live facts about one pull request whether it is finished (its checks, its tier, the session that marked it ready) before it reaches its base, and lands it only when every check passes. With `--status` it posts the verdict as the `merge-guard` commit status on the head, which is what the layer's merge-guard workflow does.

inputs.name: repo
inputs.description: The repository holding the pull request. Default: the checkout's own.

inputs.name: merge
inputs.description: Land the pull request, only if every check passes. Needs `--session`.

inputs.name: status
inputs.description: Post the verdict as the `merge-guard` commit status on the head.

inputs.name: full_tier
inputs.description: Require the full (release) tier of checks, not the fast tier a draft runs.

outputs.name: verdict
outputs.description: Each check with its verdict; exit 0 when the pull request may land.

selection.when: Before a pull request lands on its base, by the merge manager or a steward, and on every pull request event through the merge-guard workflow.
selection.limits: Reads GitHub's live facts about one pull request; it judges no declared graph.

remedies.none: The verdict is GitHub's live facts about the pull request (its checks, reviews and the session that marked it ready); with no GitHub there is nothing to judge and nothing to land.
